# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 16 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Vindobonensis) | **Section:** Personal Confession — Nearly Poured Out to Death

---

**16:1** When my soul was poured out — nearly to death,
I was near [to] the gates of Hades with the sinner,

**16:2** when my soul removed itself far from the LORD God of Israel —
had it not been that the LORD helped me with his everlasting mercy —

**16:3** I would have sunk into the sleep of death,
my soul would have been uprooted from the LORD God.

**16:4** When my soul was nearly poured out to death
and my heart was far from the LORD:

**16:5** I remembered the mercy of God in his acts of covenant-faithfulness forever;
and in his goodness he came down in mercy.

**16:6** I was unable to keep watch and thought of thee;
my soul was near [to] death and my heart was heavy.

**16:7** And I cried to thee, O LORD,
when my soul was at death's door.

**16:8** I prayed to the LORD when my heart was full;
I asked him for the mercy of the LORD,

**16:9** and thou didst hear my voice when my heart was in a [broken] trance;
and he saved my soul from death.

**16:10** My trust is in thee, O LORD;
I will not be ashamed forever.

**16:11** Keep me, O LORD, in thy mercy;
I will not fear any [other] master.

**16:12** For thou art my praise and my joy;
hope in God, for I trust in the mercies of God forever.

**16:13** I will not be afraid; for who shall be able to harm me?
The LORD is my defender;
he will not allow my life to be destroyed.

**16:14** Praised be the LORD, for he is our God,
the ruler of all the earth with his righteousness and justice.

**16:15** May the name of the LORD be praised forever;
for his glory is from age to age.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Greek (Codex Vindobonensis). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
